scope: NRCB2 transport of the frozen NGC 3447 DOLPHOT measurement-operator baseline

sources.title: DOLPHOT JWST — Examining the logs
sources.resultDate: living documentation; crawled as current on 2026-09-01
sources.supports: For a moderately populated NIRCam field, at least 100 matches with alignment sigma below 0.30 pixel, at least 100 PSF stars with absolute central-pixel adjustment below 0.05, and at least 100 aperture stars are the documented diagnostics.

sources.title: DOLPHOT JWST — Parameter definitions
sources.resultDate: living documentation; crawled as current on 2026-09-01
sources.supports: JWST reductions require UseWCS=2; FitSky=2 is described as robust over a wide crowding range; PSF residual and aperture-correction diagnostics require explicit inspection.

sources.title: NIRCam Field of View
sources.resultDate: living STScI instrument documentation; crawled on 2026-09-01
sources.supports: A NIRCam module has four short-wave detectors separated by physical gaps, so detector support must be evaluated before treating zero matches as alignment failures.

sources.title: The JWST Resolved Stellar Populations Early Release Science Program V. DOLPHOT Stellar Photometry for NIRCam and NIRISS
sources.supports: The NIRCam/NIRISS DOLPHOT modules and their crowded-field validation; it does not validate this NGC 3447 tile or cross-detector transport.

sources.title: A Perfect Host in the Distance Ladder
sources.supports: Scientific context for NGC 3447 and the distance-ladder target; it does not supply the RC71 detector-quality result.

verifiedBeforeRun: The NRCB2 parameter hash c08ad6f8f4006b88cb0927d1da5c1213ae3fcfb424f8924078de24726682771c matches the RC70 independent design audit.
The DOLPHOT 3.0 binary hash matches the NRCB1 baseline binary.
No NRCB2 output existed before execution, so the run did not overwrite a previous receipt.
The official quality thresholds and NIRCam detector-gap description remain current on the review date.
inferencesToTest: The WCS support partition should predict positive alignment only for image indices 2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, and 30.
A baseline that passed on NRCB1 may or may not transport to NRCB2 because stellar density, background, and PSF sampling can change by detector and sky region.
proposalsNotYetValidated: A two-detector pass is evidence for transport but not a licence to open the 3,072-row artificial-star test.
After four-detector qualification, an exposure-support mask should route each artificial star only to images that geometrically cover it.

statusChangeReview: No source establishes that the Hubble-tension, finite-sample transport, or post-selection problems are solved. RC71 therefore retains all scientific inference gates until detector-specific evidence is produced.
